name: Kikii Amou
source:
"Ahahaha! It's the adorable, adorable Kikii! You foolish humans. Surrender to my magic! Especially that old hag Lucil--Here we go! One-two! Boom-cha-cha! Ahaaa!"

One of [url=/c160583]ARATA[/url]'s Luden creations. Made using data from Lucil Filarete, a certain someone's memories, and a spirit that had long resided in Svetlana Amou's shop.

Think of her like a Japanese "zashiki-warashi"—a house spirit. She hates Svetlana, but not in a particularly harmful way. She's more of a loud nuisance.

However, after ARATA MIZUNASHI made her his assassin, she was twisted by destructive urges. She now finds joy in hurting people and is an incredibly dangerous entity. [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] will face her many times. Hopefully, Svetlana can eventually take her back...

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category9&ch=kiki]official website[/url]]
